then.say: Is that the key? Don't just stand there admiring it.

do.say: Free! Hah! My legs have forgotten how to be legs.
I'll make for Wick's Rest, up the hill. There's a shrine there, and folk who don't ask questions. Find me there. I'll have something for you.
Not yet? It's a key. It goes in a lock. This is a lock.

else.say: Still here. Still locked. Still hoping.

do.say: Oskar Fennick. Powder-man, same as you. Well, not the same. I only sold the stuff. You made it.
Wicklings. Pilgrims gone to wax. They don't bleed and they don't stop. Mind the candles on their heads.
The guard who ran east, down the road. He bolted with it on his belt. Can't have got far.
